messages:
jen_support: FYI customer (ACME) opened an escalation — Trace View showing no spans for a subset of request IDs. They say traces exist in logs but Trace UI shows empty link / 'No spans found'. Dashboard metric `trace_index_latency` also flatlined for ~10m. attaching customer example IDs.

miguel_sre: Can you paste a few request IDs + example timestamp? Also which region / env?

jen_support: request ids: 8a3f2c4d, b7f9e001, c12a9f00. Occurred around 2026-03-16T15:04Z in prod-us-west. Customer says they can grep spans in the ingestion logs but dashboard doesn't link. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.s3/esc/acme_missing_traces.png

sam_ml: quick hypothesis: we had an indexer retry earlier for shard-7. Could be documents accepted into raw ingestion but not indexed into trace-index due to mapping error.

ops-bot: ALERT: span-indexing-lag detected (shard-7) — avg lag 00:06:24, threshold 00:05:00. Event id: evt-20260316-1545

miguel_sre: Looking at ES logs now. Running a targeted query against trace-index for 8a3f2c4d...

miguel_sre: Query used: ```GET trace-index/_search?q=request_id:8a3f2c4d&size=50```

miguel_sre: Response: 0 hits in trace-index, but raw-ingest shows entry present. Looks like the enrichment pipeline dropped the request_id tag for some shards.

amy_product: Is the UI join logic tolerant to missing request_id tag? I thought we fallback to request header x-rw-request-id -> trace_id mapping.

sam_ml: The backend UI path does two lookups: (1) trace-index by request_id tag, (2) fallback to request-mapping store (KV) using trace_id. If the enrichment failed to set request_id we lose the primary link.

jen_support: Customer sent raw JSON for one event (redacted): ```{"timestamp":"2026-03-16T15:04:02Z","span_id":"...","tags":{"service":"payments"},"headers":{"user-agent":"curl"}}``` — notice headers missing x-rw-request-id. Customer said they upgraded their proxy yesterday.

miguel_sre: That matches: proxy upgrade dropped forwarding of x-rw-request-id for ~8m window. Enrichment pipeline relies on that header to populate request_id tag. If header missing, trace-index doc created without request_id and UI can't join.

amy_product: OK, two parallel actions: (A) get UI to fall back to request->span mapping more aggressively for these request_ids, (B) reindex missing docs once we have request IDs mapped from raw logs.

sam_ml: For (B) we can reconstruct request_id by correlating ingest logs: raw-ingest has session_id + timestamp -> use session->request mapping tool. I'll run correlation for the three IDs and queue reindex.

miguel_sre: Pre-check: running a bulk lookup to ensure docs exist and are healthy before reindex. Command: ```python tools/reindex_missing.py --ids 8a3f2c4d,b7f9e001,c12a9f00 --target trace-index```

ops-bot: NOTE: Maintenance window scheduled 2026-03-16T16:00Z for shard-7 retention job.

jen_support: Customer is asking for ETA to see traces in UI. Any quick mitigation?

sam_ml: Quick mitigation: temporarily enable fallback join by also querying raw-ingest for span docs with matching timestamp +/- 5s and surface them in UI. That requires a small API toggle; will take ~20–30m to ship safely.

miguel_sre: Running reindex script now in dry-run mode. Output: ```dry-run: 3 docs matched, will reindex to trace-index with request_id populated from header-lookup.```

miguel_sre: Executing reindex...

miguel_sre: Reindex job complete. 3 docs indexed. ES task id: task-reindex-20260316-01.

ops-bot: INFO: Reindex job task-reindex-20260316-01 finished with status completed.

jen_support: Customer confirms they now see trace detail links for 8a3f2c4d. :tada:

amy_product: Great — please file a follow-up: (1) customer RCA email + timeline, (2) a small UI fallback feature (query raw-ingest fallback), (3) add an integration test to catch proxy-header loss, (4) run postmortem for span-indexer lag.

miguel_sre: Filed INC-2026-324 in tracker, assigned to infra-team, added steps and logs. Also added a hotfix to alert thresholds for shard-7 to be more sensitive.

sam_ml: I'll push a PR for the UI fallback toggle and a unit test. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/789

jen_support: Customer update sent. They appreciated the quick turnaround. Closing escalation but keeping ticket open for follow-ups.

amy_product: Assigned follow-ups to respective owners. Thanks all.

ops-bot: REACTION: :thumbsup: (added by miguel_sre)
